name: app-black-onboarding-with-blurred-gradient-and-hardware-setup
title: Dark fitness onboarding: goal checklist, blurred violet welcome, tracker-ready and athlete sheet
whatItIs: A black case-study board with a long centred paragraph (bright and dimmed text) and four phones: a black goal list with checkbox rows, a blurred violet-blue welcome, a white 'tracker is ready' screen with a band photo, and an athlete photo with a white bottom sheet and login buttons.
whatItMeans: Calm and motivating; each screen has a different mood but one clear action.
techniques: Use a blurred gradient as a welcome screen.
Show checklists as simple rows with one selected.
Present a hardware pairing success screen.
Use a photo header with a bottom sheet.

vocabulary.definition: A screen with a soft blurred gradient.
A list of options with check boxes.
A screen confirming a device is connected.
A panel rising from the bottom.
